title: Renal Dose Adjustment: Drugs, eGFR and Safety Checks
subject: Prescription Pearls
preview: Renal drug adjustment considers the drug, kidney function estimate, route, indication and whether kidney function is stable.
quickRevision: Renal drug adjustment considers the drug, kidney function estimate, route, indication and whether kidney function is stable.
Some drugs have active renally cleared metabolites; accumulation can cause neurotoxicity, hypoglycemia or bleeding.
Reassess doses after acute kidney injury or recovery and consult the product-specific dosing guidance.

sections.title: Recognize the situation
points: Renal drug adjustment considers the drug, kidney function estimate, route, indication and whether kidney function is stable.
eGFR and creatinine clearance estimates are not always interchangeable for dosing, particularly at extremes of body size or unstable kidney function.

sections.title: Clinical decisions & differential
points: Some drugs have active renally cleared metabolites; accumulation can cause neurotoxicity, hypoglycemia or bleeding.
Reassess doses after acute kidney injury or recovery and consult the product-specific dosing guidance.

sections.title: Exam trap — avoid this mistake
points: Do not use one blanket percentage dose reduction for every renally eliminated medicine.

quiz.question: Which is safest for renal dose adjustment?
options: Drug-specific guidance with current renal assessment
Using the last year's creatinine alone
The same dose reduction for all drugs
quiz.explanation: Drug-specific guidance with current renal assessment. Renal drug adjustment considers the drug, kidney function estimate, route, indication and whether kidney function is stable.
